title: Encrypted DNS Host Resolver Installation Planning Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for deterministic host resolver installation planning.
scope: This verification covers global installation planning from service-binding and discovery inputs, fallback resolver preservation, split-tunnel domain scoping from provisioning input, and blocked non-installable plans for explicit Do53 preference or untrusted NULL-authenticated provisioning.
preconditions: The caller supplies already-validated SVCB, discovery, or provisioning client plans.
A separate platform adapter is responsible for applying the resulting plan to the host resolver.
expected_result: The focused planner tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9463 artifacts, generated triage remains trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: Host resolver installation is locally narrowed to deterministic planning. Platform resolver mutation remains external adapter work.
